---
title: "Practical 1 - Brain summary"
---

The total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain, in each of the three organisms (human, pig and mouse), can be calculated as follows:

Human
```{r}
sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
# This is a comment
```

Pig
```{r}
sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
```
Mouse
```{r}
sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
```
The human therefore had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
